page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, the instance provides dedicated, non-hyperthreaded CPU resources. It is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 9.6 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type. This hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM capacity and dedicated CPU allocation without the need for local NVMe drives or hardware acceleration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfr6.20xlarge offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it suitable for enterprise applications that demand large in-memory footprints. The dedicated core allocation ensures predictable performance by eliminating resource contention. This server type is optimized for workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics applications.
